summary: This component renders a blog post item with a header, content, footer, and optionally shows related posts. It uses a hook to determine whether we're viewing a single blog post page or a list of posts, and applies different styling accordingly—adding bottom margin only when showing posts in a list view.

explanations.12: useBlogPost() is a hook that gives us context about where we are in the app; isBlogPostPage tells us if we're viewing a single full blog post or just a preview in a list.
explanations.13: This returns a CSS class name only if we're NOT on the full blog post page (meaning we're in a list), otherwise it returns undefined so no extra margin is applied.
explanations.18: We're calling that helper function to get the appropriate class name, which will either be a margin class or undefined depending on context.
explanations.25: The double ampersand (&&) is a shortcut: only render the RelatedPosts component if isBlogPostPage is true, otherwise render nothing.
